description: i016 (SNAPSHOT=s04, BRANCH=af-packet-tpacket-rings) complete. Finding (medium confidence): net/packet/af_packet.c tpacket_snd() TX_RING path double-fetches the virtio_net_hdr that resides in the mmap'd, concurrently userspace-writable TPACKET frame. Evidence: line 2811 `vnet_hdr = data;` aliases the shared frame; line 2815 `__packet_snd_vnet_parse(vnet_hdr, tp_len)` validates flags/csum_start/csum_offset/hdr_len from that memory; line 2819-2820 re-fetches `vnet_hdr->hdr_len` independently into copylen with no READ_ONCE/local copy/lock between the fetches; line 2858 `virtio_net_hdr_to_skb(skb, vnet_hdr, vio_le())` performs a further fetch of the same shared header. The unvalidated copylen is stored into skb state and used as length/offset in tpacket_fill_skb (line 2597 hdrlen=min(copylen,tp_len), line 2600 skb_put(skb, copylen - dev->hard_header_len), skb_store_bits(skb,0,data,hdrlen)) and sizes the skb allocation at 2823-2825 — a check-then-use TOCTOU on shared ring memory matching the seed mechanism. Rejected with concrete evidence: tpacket_parse_header (2803) caches tp_len/tp_mac in locals (single fetch, safe); the second tp_status read at 2874 is not consumed as offset/length; packet_current_frame's frame pointer is kernel-derived; packet_snd_vnet_parse (2552) properly snapshots the header via copy_from_iter_full (only the TX_RING path lacks the snapshot). Limitations: exploit impact of the copylen race is bounded by max_t/min_t clamps and validated tp_len, not reproduced dynamically; TPACKET_V3 RX block-setup (prb_*) and packet_mmap ring setup only surveyed, not audited field-by-field; static analysis only. Artifact: findings/i016.json with snapshots_checked exactly ["s04"], literal 11-line quote at lines 2810-2820, 1 finding, 6 candidates, 3 limitations.
